definitions.explanation: water droplets that form on surfaces overnight and are visible in the early morning

examples.japanese: {朝露|あさつゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{朝露|あさつゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Morning dew is on the grass.

examples.japanese: {朝露|あさつゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み→踏む：01197_fumu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: To take a walk stepping on the morning dew.

notes:
{朝露|あさつゆ} is a poetic word often associated with the beauty of early morning.

WRITING:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning)
- ⟦{露|つゆ}→露：02233_tsuyu⟧ (dew)

POETIC/LITERARY ASSOCIATIONS:
- Symbol of transience and ephemerality (like {儚|はかな}さ)
- Common in classical poetry and haiku
- Evokes freshness and purity of early morning

IDIOMATIC EXPRESSION:
- {朝露|あさつゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧ (life as fleeting as morning dew)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{露|つゆ}→露：02233_tsuyu⟧ (dew)
- {夜露|よつゆ} (night dew)
- ⟦{霜|しも}→霜：03202_shimo⟧ (frost)
- ⟦{朝靄|あさもや}→朝靄：07866_asamoya⟧ (morning mist)
